bomb.desc: gold bomb: dark core, glowing equator ring and ports, warm halo

bomb_burst.desc: gold spiky bomb burst with dark flecks

missile.desc: gold drill missile, nose at +b, hot nose glow, exhaust

column.desc: gold light column / beam, foot at b 0, 1 block tall at scale 1

laser_core.desc: laser beam core, from the muzzle (b 0) along -b

muzzle.desc: laser muzzle ring with a hot centre

scorch.desc: floor scorch with a glowing gold centre

slam_ring.desc: slam shock ring (unit radius): gold band, dust fringe, flecks

wave_band.desc: gravity-wave band segment: gold-fire strip + flame wall

charge_sphere.desc: gravity-wave charge sphere with orbit swirls

flare_dome.desc: burst flare dome (half dome, pivot at the base centre)

fire_disc.desc: filled fire disc (wave start, flame band)

erupt_disc.desc: dark eruption disc with an amber rim and gold cracks

erupt_burst.desc: gold eruption burst with floor chunks, pivot at the floor

chunk.desc: floor chunk / rock with an orange crack

spike_fan.desc: floor-burst crystal-spike fan, pivot at the floor

slab.desc: glowing floor slab (box 1 x 0.27 x 0.4 at scale 1)

ousia_col.desc: violet Ousia column hanging from b 0 along -b

warp_pillar.desc: white-cyan warp pillar, pivot at the floor, 1.5 tall at scale 1

flame.desc: gold flame tongue, pivot at its root

streak.desc: long thin streak along a (tint it)

ripple.desc: ripple / shock ring (near white, tint it)

spark.doc: A small gold spark burst (tells, clicks, impacts). Billboard.

flash.doc: A white-gold glow flash (any bright moment). Billboard.

dust_puff.doc: A tan dust puff on the floor (landings, scrapes). At the floor point.

awake.doc: Entrance E0 activation: gold flare and electric arcs at the top hub, small ring lights. At the hub.

unfold.doc: Entrance +8..+14: the four pods unfold under the ring (sparks and dust at each pod). At the ring centre, rotated as the device.

crown_flare.doc: Entrance +12..+30: a gold flare as the crown assembles (call 2-3 times). At the hub top.

eye_open.doc: Entrance +38: the red-gold eye opens (glint and glow). At the eye.

rise.doc: Entrance +64..+94 (and other lift-offs): a soft gold ground ring and dust under the rising device. At the floor point under it.

ports_glow.doc: C1 +10: gold dust under the ring as the bomb ports light up (the rig's charge look lights the ports themselves; the module adds a glow card on each port anchor of its rig). At the ring centre, rotated as the device.

bomb_drop.doc: C1: a bomb falls {h} blocks from its port onto the floor point in 5 t with a short gold streak (call at the floor point; the bomb starts h above).

bomb_burst.doc: C1 bomb burst r 1.3: gold spiky burst, scorch mark, dust and sparks. At the floor point.

column_tell.doc: C1 / C2 slam tell (13 t): the gold column from the face-down core to the floor, a floor glow and a base flare. At the floor point under the core; {h} = the core height above the floor.

column_base.doc: C1 / C2 slam point (13 t) without the column: the floor glow and the base flare at the locked point while the rig's own gold column falls under the gliding device. At the floor point.

plunge.doc: C1 / C2 plunge (3-4 t): speed lines streaming up past the dropping device. At the ring centre.

slam.doc: C1 / C2 slam impact r 5: gold crystal-shard burst, shock ring, flash, dust ring. At the floor point.

pods_drop.doc: C3 +0..+4: a medallion drops beside the core (clank sparks). At the medallion.

laser_charge.doc: C3 spark charge (18 t): gold glints spin on a pod, an arc and a growing glow (call 3-4 times). At the medallion.

aim_line.doc: C3 +22: a thin white aim line flickers from the muzzle along the beam for 2 t ({len} = the beam length). At the muzzle, rotated as the beam (yaw and pitch).

laser_fire.doc: C3 +24 fire: the muzzle ring and the beam bloom (about 1 b wide for 3 t, {len} = the beam length). At the muzzle, rotated as the beam.

laser_spot.doc: C3 beam floor spot (call every 2-3 t at each spot): scorch, a gold glow and sparks.

laser_end.doc: C3 beams off: a power-down spark and smoke at the muzzle.

tip_flare.doc: C4 tell 1 (8 t; also the next-pattern tell): a gold 4-point starburst with electric arcs. At a spike tip.

vent_shaft.doc: C4 tell 2 (13 t): the vertical gold light shaft vents up from the hub, vent flames. At the hub top.

missile_launch.doc: C4 launch (each missile): vent flame and smoke puffs. At the vent.

missile_trail.doc: C4 smoke trail puff left behind a missile (call every 3 t at the missile prop).

missile_impact.doc: C4 impact r 1.5: gold crystal-spike burst, a floor glow and dust. At the floor point.

core_spark.doc: C5 tell 1: a gold spark on the core with arcs. At the core.

core_lift.doc: C5 +5 "번쩍": a gold flame burst around the core as it lifts. At the core.

dark_disc.doc: C5 / F1: the dark floor disc grows from {r0} to {r} blocks over {grow} ticks and stays to {life} (the video marker: the floor about 25-35 % darker, amber rim). At the floor point; pair with the Geo tele_disc for the timing.

up_beam.doc: C5 +29..+40: the upward gold beam from the raised core with crawling arcs. At the core.

rim_flare.doc: C5 +36..+41: the rim at the final radius {r} flares bright (last warning). At the floor centre.

column_down.doc: C5 +41..+44: the gold column down from the core through the violet pendulum glow. At the floor point under the core; {h} = the core height.

floor_hit.doc: C5 +44: the column hits the floor centre: gold crystal-shard burst. At the floor centre.

blast.doc: C5 +48 full-area blast over radius {r}: a white-gold flash over the disc, the jagged gold crack ring at the rim, a shock ring (pair with p/rocks). At the floor centre.

rocks.doc: C5 +48..+77: about a dozen floor rocks launched across the disc hover, then drift down. At the floor centre (spread r 2-11).

dip.doc: C6 +0: the dip and roll toward the player (dust kicked up and two speed lines). At the floor point under the device, rotated as it.

vent_flare.doc: C6 +12 (8 t): the vent flare bursts up from the top centre as the medallions are flung. At the hub top.

tower_up.doc: C6 +20 (18 t): gold sparks race up the telescoping tower. At the ring centre.

flame_band.doc: C6 charge (17 t): the horizontal gold flame band flares and pulses under the ring (Ø 4.5 -> 8 b) with standing flame licks. At the ring underside.

floor_burst.doc: C6 / F2 floor burst r 1.8: a gold crystal-spike fan, rock chips and a white dust ring. At the floor point.

slab_rise.doc: C6 / F2: a slab tears out of the floor (gold rim glow, dust, chips). At the floor point.

slab_throw.doc: C6 / F2 throw: white-gold streaks as the slab is flung. At the slab, rotated along the throw.

slab_trail.doc: C6 / F2: a short white-gold streak behind a flying slab (call every 2 t at the slab prop, rotated along its flight).

slab_impact.doc: C6 / F2: a slab crashes onto the floor (dust, chunks, a gold glow). At the floor point.

revert.doc: C6 end: the tower folds back (sparks and a small dust ring). At the ring centre.

halo_flip.doc: Field +0..+12: the halo flips upright (whirling gold streaks). At the halo.

warp_out.doc: Field +13 warp-out: the 1-2 frame white-cyan pillar where the device was, glitch streaks start, gold dust on the floor. At the floor point under it.

glitch.doc: Field +14..+33: violet glitch streaks drift up and out over the old spot (call every 4-5 t). At the old spot (floor).

warp_in.doc: Field +34 warp-in at the arena centre: a white-cyan bloom and a violet ring. At the core.

warp_pillar.doc: A white-cyan warp pillar standing on the floor (warp-in, the field arrival). At the floor point.

field_unfold.doc: Field +35..+51: the violet column grows under the core, violet tendrils whip out, a violet glow. At the core.

field_idle.doc: Field idle (every 10-20 t): violet crackle under the core. At the core.

pebbles.doc: Field (every 20 t around the player): pebbles float up slowly, the low-gravity cue (r 1.5-5 around, never at the eyes). At the player's feet.

gold_streaks.doc: Field charge cue: gold streaks rise from the floor around the device (r 2-6). At the floor point under it.

wave_charge.doc: 「인력 충격파」 charge: the yellow sphere grows around the lower core over {t} ticks with a glow and arcs (24 t, the third 40 t). At the core.

wave_pulse.doc: 「인력 충격파」 charge pulse (call every 8 t of the charge): streaks converge on the sphere and a glint flares. At the core.

wave_beam.doc: 「인력 충격파」 the 1-2 tick vertical gold beam core -> floor with a floor splash ({h} = the core height). At the floor point under the core.

wave_burst.doc: 「인력 충격파」 burst: the white-gold flare dome (4 b wide, 2 b tall), then the filled fire disc r 1.8 (5 t) where the ring starts. At the floor point.

wave_band.doc: 「인력 충격파」 the expanding gold-fire ring: 16 band segments (flat burning strip + standing flame wall) travel from radius {r0} to {r1} in {dur} ticks keeping the band {w} deep (tenths of a block / ticks, like the hazards). Call it on the tick BEFORE the strike: it then starts moving in the strike tick, with the tele/wave front and the hz/ring front. At the floor centre.

wave_fire.doc: 「인력 충격파」 flames and embers on the travelling front at radius {r} blocks (particles only; call every 3 t with the front radius). At the floor centre.

erupt_tell.doc: F1 감소 영역: a dark disc r 2.8 fades in over 6 t (15 t lead; pair with tele_disc el 9). At the zone floor point.

erupt.doc: F1 eruption r 2.8: the gold burst mound with floor chunks, a crack ring, flung rocks and dust. At the zone floor point.

debris.doc: After an eruption: a few chunks hover 0.3-2.5 b over the zone, then drift down. At the zone floor point.

meter_glint.doc: Break meter: the crack glint on the bubble at each count. At the core.

bubble_crack.doc: Break meter stage (counts 5, 10, 15): a big crack flash, glass flakes and a glow. At the core.

bubble_glow.doc: Break +0..+5: the cracked bubble lights up white-gold before it bursts. At the core.

break_burst.doc: Break +5: the bubble bursts: a white flash, flying glass shards, a big crack glint and a thin ring. At the core.

break_ring.doc: Break +5: the horizontal gold spark ring expands at floor level (r 9 in 9 t). At the floor point under the core.

groggy_sparks.doc: Groggy (every 30-40 t): slow sparks drip from the slumped core with a wisp of smoke. At the core.

sink_dust.doc: Break +34: the device sinks low (dust ring under it). At the floor point under it.

recover.doc: Groggy end: re-level and the core flips to the top (a gold ring flash and sparks). At the core.

lift_off.doc: Field end (unbroken) +23: the lift-off pulse under the device (white-gold burst, r 3 ring, dust). At the floor point under it.

pack_up.doc: Field end: sparks as the lances dock and the device packs into the compact form. At the ring centre, rotated as the device.

death_flicker.doc: Death: one flicker of the dying seam (call 3 times, 4-6 t apart). At the core.

death_fall.doc: Death: the ring lands tilted on the floor (dust ring, chunks). At the floor point under it.

death_fade.doc: Death tail (every 10-15 t while it scales out): gold motes and sparks rise. Around the core.

props.bomb: C1 bomb: the camera-facing gold bomb, 0.9 across (vertical billboard, so a falling bomb stays upright).
props.missile: C4 drill missile: nose along the prop's facing (local +z; aim it with tp ... facing), 1.3 long.
props.slab: C6 / F2 glowing slab: a box 2.2 x 0.6 x 0.9 b (length along local x), full bright rim.
props.laser_core: C3 beam core: hangs from the prop along local -y (pitch the prop down the beam: rotation pitch = beam pitch - 90), 0.45 wide; set scale y = the beam length.
props.laser_glow: C3 beam glow sleeve: as laser_core, 1 b wide; scale x / z 0.5 -> 1.0 -> 0.5 for the bloom.
props.column: Gold column standing on the prop (local +y), 1.1 wide; set scale y = the height.
props.ousia_col: Violet Ousia column hanging from the prop (local -y), 1 wide; set scale y = the length.
props.bubble0: Core bubble overlay, crack stage 0 (meter counts 0-4), 2.4 across, camera-facing; swap stages with this prop as the meter climbs.
props.bubble1: Core bubble overlay, crack stage 1 (meter counts 5-9), 2.4 across, camera-facing; swap stages with this prop as the meter climbs.
props.bubble2: Core bubble overlay, crack stage 2 (meter counts 10-14), 2.4 across, camera-facing; swap stages with this prop as the meter climbs.
props.bubble3: Core bubble overlay, crack stage 3 (meter counts 15-19), 2.4 across, camera-facing; swap stages with this prop as the meter climbs.

sounds.awake_clank: Activation clank (entrance E0): a sharp metallic clank with a bright tail.
sounds.unfold: Pods unfold and the crown assembles (entrance +8..+30): low thumps and gear clicks.
sounds.gear_click: Crown gear clicks (call 2-3 times while the crown assembles; quiet).
sounds.eye_open: The eye opens and the core drum turns (entrance +32..+64): a low mechanical groan and a click.
sounds.rise_hum: The device rises to cruise height (entrance +64..+94; also field lift-offs): whirring hum.
sounds.bomb_port: Underside bomb ports light up (C1 +10): shutters and a rising charge.
sounds.bomb_drop: A bomb leaves a port (C1, every 2-4 t; quiet).
sounds.bomb_fall: Falling whistle of a bomb (C1, once per volley group).
sounds.bomb_burst: A bomb bursts on the floor (C1, per landing): short crack and crystal.
sounds.column_tell: Gold slam column projects to the floor (C1 / C2, 13 t tell): rising hum.
sounds.plunge: The device plunges core first (C1 / C2, 3-4 t): whoosh and a hydraulic drop.
sounds.slam: Slam impact r 5 (C1 / C2): heavy boom, anvil and debris.
sounds.pods_drop: The medallions dock and drop beside the core (C3 +0..+4): clank.
sounds.laser_charge: Laser spark charge (C3, 18 t): bright rising whine.
sounds.laser_fire: The two beams fire (C3 +24): hissing burst.
sounds.laser_loop: Beam loop (C3, every 10 t while firing, at the floor spots): hum and crackle.
sounds.laser_stop: Beams off and pods retract (C3 end): power-down.
sounds.tip_flare: Spike-tip flare (C4 tell 1; also the next-pattern tell): crackle.
sounds.missile_vent: Top vents open with the vertical gold shaft (C4 tell 2): roaring hiss.
sounds.missile_launch: A drill missile launches (C4, per missile).
sounds.missile_dive: Missiles turn over and dive (C4, once per volley group): falling whistle.
sounds.missile_impact: A missile hits the floor (C4, per impact): crack and boom.
sounds.core_flip: The core flips (C5 lift, the field core flip, groggy recover): clank and whoosh.
sounds.core_spark: Gold spark on the core (C5 tell 1): dense crackle.
sounds.core_lift: The core lifts with a gold flare (C5 +5, "번쩍"): bright flare.
sounds.up_beam: Upward gold beam from the raised core (C5 +29..+40): rising crackle.
sounds.column_down: The column switches down to the floor centre (C5 +41): zap.
sounds.blast: Full-area gravity blast (C5 +48): big broadband boom, rocks launched.
sounds.rocks_hover: Rocks hover after the blast (C5 +54..+77, every 6-10 t; quiet): low rumble.
sounds.dip: Dip and roll toward the player (C6 +0): whoosh.
sounds.vent_flare: Vent flare, the medallions flung up (C6 +12): roaring hiss.
sounds.tower_up: The tower telescopes up (C6 +20, 18 t): ratchet clicks.
sounds.flame_charge: The flame band flares under the ring (C6 charge, 17 t): rising roar.
sounds.floor_burst: A floor burst erupts (C6 / F2, per burst): crystal crack and thump.
sounds.slab_lift: A slab tears out and rises (C6 / F2, after each burst; quiet): grinding rise.
sounds.slab_throw: A slab is flung at the player (C6 / F2, per throw): heavy whoosh.
sounds.revert: The tower collapses back into the ring (C6 end): clunk.
sounds.halo_flip: The halo flips upright before the warp (field +0): whoosh.
sounds.warp_out: Warp-out flash (field +13): bright zap and a low whoomp.
sounds.glitch: Violet glitch crackle (field +14..+33 over the old spot, field idle; quiet).
sounds.field_unfold: The stack unfolds into the field form (field +35..+51): springs and chains.
sounds.field_hum: Low-gravity field drone (every 40 t while the field is up; quiet).
sounds.field_banner: The banner "중력이 감소하고 점프 능력이 향상됩니다" appears (field +57).
sounds.wave_charge: 「인력 충격파」 charge, start (24 t / 40 t): rising airy hiss.
sounds.wave_charge2: 「인력 충격파」 charge, the last 10 t: higher.
sounds.wave_beam: 「인력 충격파」 1-tick beam core -> floor: thump and zap.
sounds.wave_burst: 「인력 충격파」 burst flare dome: boom and roar.
sounds.wave_ring: 「인력 충격파」 front travelling (every 2-3 t at the front point nearest the player; quiet): rumble.
sounds.erupt_tell: 감소 영역 dark discs appear (F1, per event; quiet).
sounds.erupt: 감소 영역 gold eruption (F1, per event): crack and gravel burst.
sounds.debris_land: Debris settles after an eruption or the blast (quiet).
sounds.meter_tick: A break-meter count (each counted hit): crystalline ping on brass (hud/meter_hit adds a note that rises with the count).
sounds.bubble_crack: The core bubble cracks a stage further (counts 5, 10, 15).
sounds.break_glow: The bubble lights up before the burst (break +0..+5).
sounds.break_burst: The bubble bursts: the field is broken (break +5).
sounds.groggy_wobble: Tilt and damped wobble (break +5..+34): metallic groan.
sounds.groggy_spark: Slow sparks while groggy (every 30-40 t; quiet).
sounds.recover: Re-level and core flip back to cruise (groggy end): clockwork.
sounds.lift_off: Lift-off pulse when the field ends unbroken (field end +23).
sounds.pack_up: Lances deploy and the device packs into the compact form (field end): mechanical whirr.
sounds.death: Death: the seam flickers out and the stack collapses (no voices).
sounds.death_fall: Halo, pods and ring hit the floor (death).
sounds.death_fade: The device scales out with gold sparks (death tail).
